title: Cheesy Chicken and Rice Bake (Partial — Video Only)
ingredients: 1 box Knorr rice or pasta side dish
Cream of chicken soup (a low-sodium version recommended by a commenter)
instructions: Combine the Knorr rice/pasta side, cream of chicken soup, and chicken broth in a baking dish.
Lay chicken tenders (with silver skin/tendons trimmed off) on top of the rice mixture.
Bake everything together in one dish until the chicken is cooked through and the rice is tender.
Serve — the poster called it 'probably the easiest dinner' since everything bakes in one dish.
notes: Video only — exact quantities, pan size, and bake time/temperature were not stated on camera or in the caption. The creator (Behind the Family Lens) sent the full written recipe privately via DM to one commenter (Karen Brady) rather than posting it publicly; several other commenters (Jelena Allen, Melanie Cook Bishop, Gwynneth Torbett) also asked for the recipe and did not get a public answer. Suggested variations from commenters: add frozen broccoli or peas & carrots (it was compared to chicken pot pie); substitute orzo for the rice; use plain seasoned rice instead of Knorr (a few found the Knorr flavor off-putting); use low-sodium canned soup/broth; top with crushed Ritz crackers instead of cheese; mix the cream of chicken and broth in a saucepan first before pouring over rice.
